scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 67 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-stone-circle-the-english-lake-dis.story: A 258 km round trip from Bardon Mill - roughly 4 h 27 in the saddle. It goes by way of Hadrian's Wall vallum between east side of, The English Lake District and back through Hadrian's Wall vallum between east side of. Lakes are the scenery here.
